description: Use this when the person has no account or key yet, or asks how to connect an agent. Takes no input. Returns the sign-up link, what test and live keys are, how this MCP server is reached and signed in to, and the links to the docs and the OpenAPI document. Do not use this to check a key the person already has: any tool that works with cases says so when its key is missing or refused. No key needed.
name: evictions_get_started
title: Get started
